root_cause.component: standalone router account panel JSON XMLHttpRequest adapter
root_cause.failure: The adapter set XMLHttpRequest.responseType to json, then read responseText when response was null. Browsers throw InvalidStateError because responseText is inaccessible for the json response type.
root_cause.effect: Initial or periodic status refresh could terminate before rendering, and a successful switch could be reported as rejected when the mandatory post-switch refresh threw the same exception.

failure_first.assertion: A JSON XHR panel must not read request.responseText.

implementation.change: Use only XMLHttpRequest.response for the explicitly configured json response type; invalid or empty JSON continues to fail closed in the existing schema validation.

tests.command: bash -n evidence/M6.9/deploy-router-r97-xhr-switch-repair.sh; node --check panel and installer; git diff --check

live_manual_switch.path: fresh trusted 8216 browser session with same-origin CSRF protection

browser_observation.exception_source: router account panel JSON XHR load handler
browser_observation.reason: After the service restart, Browser Use blocked further direct HTTP page inspection under its URL policy. No alternate browser surface or policy workaround was attempted.

r96_baseline.reason: The requested clean-browser performance baseline was interrupted by this correctness incident. R97 changed the deployed panel bytes, so partial R95 timing observations are not a valid post-repair baseline and were not recorded as R96 results.

residual_risks: The browser-control policy prevented an automated post-deployment DOM assertion on the direct HTTP page; the failure-first XHR test, installed asset hashes and fresh protected session switch roundtrip passed independently.
The user browser must reload once so the old R95 document and invalidated pre-restart session are replaced by R97.
Every accepted switch starts a new backend session; no prior session, failed request, semantic stream, in-flight work or running computation is resumed.
R96 startup profiling remains pending and must use R97 as its new production input if the user resumes it.
